desc:
🔍 You or your Opponent chooses a number! ❓
🎨 While one finds a number, the other Paints Their Picture!
🔄 Switch turns once the number has been found!
💀 Paint your whole canvas before your Opponent or LOSE!

Be quick in finding the number as well as painting the picture on the canvas!!

Join our group! Report any bugs on the forum! 🐛
